DIAMETER::dynamic_route_insertion
Description
This iRules command gets or sets whether dynamic route insertion is enabled. If status is set to “enabled”, a
dynamic route will be created for this connection.
This value, once set, remains for the life of the connection.
After the connection is closed, this route will be removed once “timeout” seconds have elapsed.  The default timeout
is set by the configuration option “dynamic-route-timeout”.
The zero-argument form of this command returns whether the setting is enabled on the current connection.
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
dynamic_route_insertion
[
enabled
]
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
([
IP
::
address
]
starts_with
"192.168."
)
}
{
DIAMETER
::
dynamic_route_insertion
disabled
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED, SERVER_CONNECTED
Introduced: LTM-15.0
